comment: Against the real Colosseum home screen (an isolated session, never the daily pipe — see the L2 report for the exact isolated-session replay). Targets are the four TopBar mode pills (qml/TopBar.qml's Pill component, objectName 'modePill_' + label) — the one always-present, always-named actionable row on home. Wait bootSplash visible==false before driving/reading (ledger trap: clicks/reads land on the occluded tree while it owns the screen). '$rootWindow' is the synthetic whole-window viewport LayoutSnapshot builds from dump-ui's own rootWindow field.
